english.note: This is the all-purpose choice when “shot” means an opportunity or chance to try.

exampleSentences.english: I finally got a shot to try this time.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我今次終於有機會試吓。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 ci3 zung1 jyu1 jau5 gei1 wui6 si3 haa5

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an opportunity or an attainable possibility.

exampleSentences.english: I finally got a chance to travel to Japan.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我終於有機會去日本旅行。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 jyu1 jau5 gei1 wui6 heoi3 jat6 bun2 leoi5 hang4

english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a chance to advance, make progress, or profit.

exampleSentences.english: This job offers an opportunity for promotion.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 fan6 gung1 jau5 gei1 wui6 sing1 zik1

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a favorable or timely opportunity.

exampleSentences.english: This trip gave me an occasion to meet my idol.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢次旅行畀咗我一個機會見偶像。
